title: adr-authoring-template template variables
description: Values for templates/adr-authoring-template.md.j2 and templates/adr-authoring-template.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from adr-authoring-template.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

adr_number.title: Adr number
adr_number.description: The sequence number, zero-padded to four digits here (0007) because adr-lint.sh greps for ADR-NNNN. Next free number in docs/adr; never reused.

adr_title.title: Adr title
adr_title.description: Short noun phrase naming what is being decided, not the option that won. "Session storage for checkout", not "Adopt Redis" - the title has to still read true after a superseding ADR.

context.title: Context
context.description: The situation and the forces - technical, business, team. Factual and value-neutral, constraints included. Tell me the numbers and the deadline; do not argue the case here.

date.title: Date
date.description: The day the deciders actually agreed, ISO (2026-08-15) - not the day you wrote it up. The gap between those two dates is itself worth knowing.

deciders.title: Deciders
deciders.description: Who decided, as handles - "@olena, @taras". List only the people whose objection would have changed the outcome; everyone else was in the room, not in the decision.

decision_choice.title: Decision choice
decision_choice.description: The specific thing you will do, phrased to complete "We will ___". A concrete choice, not a direction - "move session state to Redis with a 30-minute TTL", not "improve session handling".

decision_scope.title: Decision scope
decision_scope.description: What the decision binds, phrased to complete "for ___". Name the systems, services or teams it applies to - and by omission, the ones it does not.
